shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Wegfahren.
shots.action: the old potato attendant stands calmly in front of a yellow Lamborghini parked across two wheelchair spots, the truffle rich kid leaning on the car
shots.motion: slow push-in, Erwin does not move

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Weißt du, wer ich bin?
shots.action: Leon smirking, sunglasses pushed up, spinning his car key on one finger
shots.motion: he spins the key and smirks

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Einer, der falsch parkt.
shots.action: Erwin looking at the wheelchair sign, then back at Leon
shots.motion: he glances at the sign, then back

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Ich bin Leon von Trüffel. Mein Vater hat dieses Parkhaus gebaut.
shots.action: Leon spreading his arms toward the garage
shots.motion: he gestures around arrogantly

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Dann weiß er ja, wofür die blauen Schilder sind.
shots.action: Erwin pointing calmly at the blue wheelchair sign
shots.motion: he points slowly at the sign

shots.speaker: MIA
shots.text: Leon, alle filmen schon.
shots.action: Mia pulling Leon's sleeve, a crowd of shoppers filming with phones in the background
shots.motion: she tugs his sleeve, people raise their phones

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Fünfhundert Euro. Und du hast mich nie gesehen.
shots.action: Leon stuffing a stack of cash into the chest pocket of Erwin's vest
shots.motion: he pushes the cash into the pocket

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Steck das weg, Junge.
shots.action: Erwin pulling the money out and handing it back without looking at it
shots.motion: he hands the money back calmly

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Abschleppdienst. Ebene minus zwei.
shots.action: Erwin speaking into his walkie-talkie, eyes fixed on Leon
shots.motion: he presses the radio button

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Das traust du dich nicht.
shots.action: Leon laughing in disbelief
shots.motion: he laughs nervously

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Mein Lambo?!
shots.action: a tow truck lifting the yellow Lamborghini, Leon running after it, the crowd laughing and filming
shots.motion: the car rises on the tow truck, Leon chases it

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Ab jetzt hundertachtzig Euro mehr.
shots.action: Erwin writing a ticket
shots.motion: he tears off the ticket

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Das wirst du bereuen, Kartoffel. Ich schwör's dir.
shots.action: Leon's furious face, the crowd's phone flashes reflecting in his eyes
shots.motion: he steps right up to Erwin's face

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Das haben schon ganz andere gesagt.
shots.action: Erwin unimpressed, sticking the ticket on Leon's chest
shots.motion: he sticks the ticket on Leon's jacket

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Papa! Ein Parkwächter hat meinen Lambo abschleppen lassen!
shots.action: Leon storming into the dark office, his father at the fireplace with a glass of whisky
shots.motion: Leon bursts in, father slowly turns

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Ein Parkwächter?
shots.action: the truffle father raising an eyebrow
shots.motion: he puts the glass down

shots.speaker: LEON
shots.text: Zweihunderttausend Aufrufe. Alle lachen über uns.
shots.action: Leon holding up his phone showing the viral video
shots.motion: he shoves the phone toward his father

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Niemand lacht über uns. Morgen ist der Mann arbeitslos.
shots.action: the father with cold eyes, fire behind him
shots.motion: slow push-in, the fire crackles

shots.speaker: BETREIBER
shots.text: Herr von Trüffel! Welche Ehre.
shots.action: the nervous pear operator jumping up from his desk as the father enters
shots.motion: he jumps up and offers his hand

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Entlassen Sie Ihren Parkwächter. Heute noch.
shots.action: the father ignoring the handshake
shots.motion: he does not take the hand

shots.speaker: BETREIBER
shots.text: Erwin? Das… das kann ich nicht.
shots.action: the pear sweating, wiping his forehead
shots.motion: he wipes sweat from his forehead

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Ich habe dieses Gebäude gebaut.
shots.action: the father leaning over the desk
shots.motion: he leans in threateningly

shots.speaker: BETREIBER
shots.text: Sie haben das Gebäude gebaut. Aber nicht den Boden darunter.
shots.action: the pear looking down at the floor
shots.motion: he points down at the floor

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Was soll das heißen?
shots.action: the father frowning
shots.motion: his eyes narrow

shots.speaker: BETREIBER
shots.text: Fragen Sie ihn selbst.
shots.action: the pear looking through the glass at Erwin in his booth below
shots.motion: he looks down through the glass

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Bodo. Ebene minus zwei. Bring dem Alten Respekt bei.
shots.action: the father on the phone at the window at night
shots.motion: he hangs up coldly

shots.speaker: BODO
shots.text: Du bist also der Parkwächter.
shots.action: the huge coconut security man and two guards walking toward Erwin's booth
shots.motion: heavy footsteps, they surround the booth

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Guten Abend, Bodo. Wie geht's deiner Mutter?
shots.action: Erwin calmly sipping coffee from a thermos cup
shots.motion: he sips his coffee, not looking up

shots.speaker: BODO
shots.text: Woher kennst du meine Mutter?
shots.action: Bodo frozen, confused
shots.motion: he stops dead

shots.speaker: ERWIN
shots.text: Ich hab sie damals aus den Trümmern getragen. Du warst vier.
shots.action: Erwin looking up at Bodo for the first time
shots.motion: he looks up slowly

shots.speaker: BODO
shots.text: …Herr Knolle?
shots.action: Bodo's eyes widening, the hard face softening
shots.motion: his face slowly changes

shots.speaker: BODO
shots.text: Sorry, Chef. Für diesen Mann rühr ich keinen Finger.
shots.action: Bodo on the phone, stepping back from the booth, signalling his guards to leave
shots.motion: he waves his guards away and hangs up

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Finden Sie alles über diesen Mann heraus. Alles.
shots.action: the father at his desk, the walnut detective standing in front of it
shots.motion: the father slides a photo of Erwin across the desk

shots.speaker: DETEKTIV
shots.text: Wird erledigt.
shots.action: the detective putting the photo in his coat
shots.motion: he nods and turns

shots.speaker: DETEKTIV
shots.text: Erwin Knolle. Neun Jahre Gefängnis. Wegen eines Hauseinsturzes.
shots.action: the detective placing a thick folder stamped GEHEIM on the desk
shots.motion: he drops the folder on the desk

shots.speaker: VATER
shots.text: Nein… das kann nicht sein. Er ist…
shots.action: the father staring at an old photo from the folder showing a potato man holding a little truffle boy on a potato field, his hand trembling
shots.motion: his hand trembles, slow push-in, the fire flickers
